style.css:
@-moz-document domain("anitaku.bz") {
/* General visibility hiding */
    .style-scope:nth-child(14) > #content #thumbnail .yt-core-image,
    h1,
    #st-1,
    .logo,
    .anime_video,
    .anime_video_body_cate,
    .movie:nth-child(1),
    .menu_top_link,
    div:nth-child(10),
    .ads_watch_top > div,
    .list_dowload span,
    .episode_video,
    .vidhide > a,
    .vidcdn > a,
    .mp4upload > a,
    .streamwish > a,
    .anime > .active,
    .content_right,
    .menu_top > ul,
    .notice-400,
    footer,
    .anime_muti_link > ul {
        display: none !important;
    }

    /* Specific styling for episode navigation arrows */
    .anime_video_body_episodes_r > a,
    .anime_video_body_episodes_l > a {
        display: inline-block; /* Makes the link behave like a block element */
        font-size: 12px; /* Font size for the arrows */
        color: #808080; /* Gray color */
        text-decoration: none; /* Removes underline */
        font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; /* Sets font */
        padding: 10px 5px; /* Adjusted padding for a better layout */
        cursor: pointer; /* Shows a pointer cursor on hover */
        transition: color 0.3s ease; /* Smooth transition effect */
    }
}
